+/**
+ * Return the port when the host matches the configured VSCODE_PROXY_URI.
+ *
+ * This supports templates whose port is not an entire subdomain, such as
+ * `https://{{port}}-code.example.com`.  Only templates under an explicitly
+ * configured proxy domain are considered, so a VSCODE_PROXY_URI for an
+ * unrelated host cannot turn this server into a proxy for that host.
+ */
+const maybeProxyFromUri = (host: string, proxyDomains: string[]): string | undefined => {
+  const template = process.env.VSCODE_PROXY_URI
+  const placeholder = "code-server-port-placeholder"
+  if (!template || !template.includes("{{port}}")) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const uri = new URL(template.replace("{{port}}", placeholder))
+    const templateHost = uri.hostname.toLowerCase()
+    if (
+      !templateHost.includes(placeholder) ||
+      !proxyDomains.some((proxyDomain) => templateHost === proxyDomain || templateHost.endsWith(`.${proxyDomain}`))
+    ) {
+      return undefined
+    }
+
+    const escapedHost = templateHost.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, "\\\\$&")
+    const matcher = new RegExp(`^${escapedHost.replace(placeholder, "([0-9]+)")}$`)
+    return matcher.exec(host.toLowerCase())?.[1]
+  } catch {
+    // Relative proxy URIs are handled by the path proxy, not this router.
+    return undefined
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * Return the port when the host matches the configured VSCODE_PROXY_URI.
+ *
+ * This supports templates whose port is not an entire subdomain, such as
+ * `https://{{port}}-code.example.com`.  Only templates under an explicitly
+ * configured proxy domain are considered, so a VSCODE_PROXY_URI for an
+ * unrelated host cannot turn this server into a proxy for that host.
+ */
+const maybeProxyFromUri = (host: string, proxyDomains: string[]): string | undefined => {
+  const template = process.env.VSCODE_PROXY_URI
+  const placeholder = "code-server-port-placeholder"
+  if (!template || !template.includes("{{port}}")) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const uri = new URL(template.replace("{{port}}", placeholder))
+    const templateHost = uri.hostname.toLowerCase()
+    if (
+      !templateHost.includes(placeholder) ||
+      !proxyDomains.some((proxyDomain) => templateHost === proxyDomain || templateHost.endsWith(`.${proxyDomain}`))
+    ) {
+      return undefined
+    }
+
+    const escapedHost = templateHost.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, "\\\\$&")
+    const matcher = new RegExp(`^${escapedHost.replace(placeholder, "([0-9]+)")}$`)
+    return matcher.exec(host.toLowerCase())?.[1]
+  } catch {
+    // Relative proxy URIs are handled by the path proxy, not this router.
+    return undefined
+  }

- It only applies when the template is under a configured `--proxy-domain`.
- Added tests for standard, hyphenated, and non-matching hostnames.
- Documented the configuration in [guide.md](/app/docs/guide.md:338).
